title: Easton Farmers' Market
desc: The country's oldest continuous open-air market, running since 1752. Produce, baked goods, flowers and more from regional growers.

title: Easton Farmers' Market (Wednesday)
desc: The midweek evening market on the square, June through September.

title: After-work vinyl set
desc: A local DJ spins soul and funk 45s.

title: Trivia night
desc: Teams of up to six. Winners get a bottle for the table.

title: Comedy night
desc: A touring stand-up headliner with a local opener.

title: Toddler story time
desc: Picture books, songs and a craft. Ages 1–4 with a grown-up.

title: Open studio: print a tote
desc: Pull your own two-color print on a tote bag.

title: Art after dark walk
desc: Galleries and studios stay open late. Pick up a walking map at the square.

title: Pasta-making class
desc: Make two shapes by hand and eat them.

title: Kids' craft morning
desc: Drop-in crafts at the play table.

title: Trail cleanup
desc: Gloves and bags provided. Meet at the trail sign.

title: Ceramics sale
desc: Seconds and new planters, priced to go.
